run_asr_prep_json: run the CLI tool to prepare ASR JSON data from audio dirs and labels
process_sample_audio: process a single audio sample to extract length, tokens, and token IDs
build_asr_dataset_json: build a JSON dataset from audio files, labels, and a sentencepiece model
encode_labels_with_spm: encode speech recognition labels using a sentencepiece model and fairseq dictionary
parallel_process_audio_samples: parallel process multiple audio samples using ThreadPoolExecutor to generate utterance data
